title: Multimodal Intelligence & Perception Hub
summary: Unifies FRIDAY's independent perception systems into one cognitive intelligence. Vision, audio, and spatial publish per-modality observations; the Hub fuses them into a single UnifiedObservation, combines confidences, performs first-level reasoning, maintains the active context + a chronological timeline, forwards understanding to the World Model (the Hub is the unified gateway), and remembers only meaningful, non-duplicate events. Built additively on the M16 service layer — the Hub imports no subsystem's internals.
objective: Every observation becomes ONE unified cognitive event: Vision + Audio + Spatial + Memory -> Perception Hub -> Unified Observation -> World Model -> Executive -> Memory -> Learning.
pipeline: modality observations -> FUSE -> CONFIDENCE gate (+enrich) -> REASON -> CONTEXT update -> TIMELINE -> World Model (gateway) -> Memory (dedup/compress) -> events

components.fusion: MultimodalFusion — group co-occurring modality observations by location into one UnifiedObservation
components.confidence: ConfidenceEngine — noisy-OR fusion + agreement boost + conflict penalty; handles conflicts gracefully
components.hub: PerceptionHub — orchestrator; never-raises; thread-safe; World Model gateway

public_api: perceive() -> summary   # pull from vision/audio/spatial services
start(interval) / stop() / dashboard() / metrics() / health() / manifest() / attach(runtime)
invariants: subsystems communicate ONLY through services (no internal imports, no circular deps)
the Hub is the unified multimodal gateway to the World Model for fused observations
only meaningful, non-duplicate unified observations are remembered (compression)
the Hub never raises (a perception fault cannot crash the Cognitive Core)
incomplete observations are enriched from context before rejection
